questions.q: The fixo is hiding. Tap the space where the fixo plays in the 3-1.
options: Behind the ball, in the middle
Ahead of the ball, in the middle
questions.explain: Yes. The fixo stays behind the ball, so there is always a safe pass back.
choiceExplanations: Yes. The fixo stays behind the ball, so there is always a safe pass back.
That space is ahead of the ball. The fixo stays behind the ball to give a safe pass back.
That is out wide in the corner. The fixo stays in the middle, behind the ball, to help both sides.

questions.q: True or false? In 3-1, the goalkeeper is one of the three.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. 3-1 counts only the four outfield players: the fixo and two alas, then one pivot.
choiceExplanations: Not quite. The goalkeeper is separate. 3-1 counts only the four outfield players.
Right, it's false. 3-1 counts only the four outfield players: the fixo and two alas, then one pivot.

options: Long pass across to the left ala
questions.explain: Yes. The fixo is behind the ball with a clear lane, so we keep the ball and try again.
choiceExplanations: A defender stands in that lane, so the pass could be cut out.
